Hanimaadhoo|Maldives.f: Hanimaadhoo hit 35.8 C on 27 February 2025, the highest temperature ever recorded in the Maldives.

Bilibino|Russia.f: Bilibino had the world's northernmost nuclear power plant, opened in January 1974 with four 12 MWe reactors.

Udachny|Russia.f: A 1.7 kiloton nuclear bomb was detonated 98 meters underground near Udachny on 2 October 1974 to help build a tailings dam.

Khatanga|Russia.f: Khatanga is called the northernmost town in the world below the treeline, as its summers are warm enough for larch trees.

Sabetta|Russia.f: Sabetta is home to a large LNG plant capable of producing 16.5 million tons of liquefied natural gas per year.

Bovanenkovo|Russia.f: The Bovanenkovo gas field was found in 1972 but only began production in 2012, served by a 572 km railway opened in 2011.

Novy Urengoy|Russia.f: Novy Urengoy was founded in 1975 after the Urengoy gas field was found, and is the last significant stop on the railway north from Tyumen.

Igarka|Russia.f: Igarka lies 163 km north of the Arctic Circle and has recorded a low of -55.2 C.

Vorkuta|Russia.f: Vorkuta holds the coldest recorded temperature of any European city, -52 C, and began as a Gulag coal-mining camp in 1932.

Chokurdah|Russia.f: No year-round road reaches Chokurdakh, and its record low is -54.4 C, set on 9 January 1964.

Khonuu|Russia.f: Khonuu has no railroads or paved roads, with winter averages of -40 to -45 C and absolute lows below -60 C.

Srednekolymsk|Russia.f: Srednekolymsk was a 17th-century trade hub at the head of navigation for seagoing koches and on the overland route to the Indigirka.

Maamigili|Maldives.f: Maamigili is naturally round, and over 73 hectares of lagoon were reclaimed to build its airport.

Cherskiy|Russia.f: Chersky is named after Jan Czerski, a Polish geographer who led several expeditions around the area in the 1880s.

Kadhdhoo|Maldives.f: Kadhdhoo, Gan, Maandhoo and Fonadhoo are joined by causeways into about 18 km of land, the longest dry stretch in the Maldives.

Saskylakh|Russia.f: No year-round road reaches Saskylakh, only a 600 km winter road south to Udachny, and it has recorded -60.3 C.

Zhigansk|Russia.f: Zhigansk was founded in 1632 as an ostrog by Cossacks led by Pyotr Beketov.

Amderma|Russia.f: Amderma fell from 541 residents in 2010 to an estimated 5 in 2024, and its fluorite mines were abandoned in the 1990s.
